scope: Evidence packaging and decision update only; no new execution is inferred from copying receipts. These historical gates do not certify later prerequisite compiler changes.

gates.ci_capture_note: Raw CI capture local_baseline field predates completion; baseline-receipt.json and verified baseline.log supersede that pending field.

criteria.criterion: Actual WasmGC through prototype and pinned Wasmtime
criteria.conclusion: Bounded original/mutated two-fragment graphs execute; not a general source compiler.

criteria.criterion: Shared recursive GC types, rooted captured closure after GC, ABI gate
criteria.conclusion: 92 actual fragment-pair executions decode exact 9/13 after GC and check ABI initializer rejection/control.

criteria.criterion: Original source analysis, binding identity, metadata, macro children; pinned/native observations
criteria.conclusion: Genuine native facts pass strict MLIR parse/print twice and source-v2 preservation/correspondence; pinned binary64 and native printed 9/13 remain separate observations.

criteria.criterion: Effectful control flow and exception/cleanup; continuation/cancellation work identified
criteria.conclusion: Seven closed examples match values, ordered effects and counts; no scheduler completeness claim.

criteria.criterion: Assess WasmSSA and alternative GC/call/EH routes
criteria.conclusion: Pinned definitions/direct probes expose missing GC, recursive groups, typed calls and EH; local dialect/export/Rust reconstruction reuses existing emitter.

criteria.criterion: Complexity, diagnostics, verifiers, dependencies, reproducibility, latency and sizes
criteria.conclusion: Raw paired samples and artifact hashes/sizes retained; excluded source-to-MLIR, build and runtime costs prevent maintenance/performance superiority claims.

criteria.criterion: Publish recommendation with risks and smallest integration boundary
criteria.conclusion: Recommend deferral. Optional analysis adapter is a future proposal; adoption still requires a separate reviewed architectural decision.

publication_gate: New documentation checkpoint still requires independent review, unchanged full workspace baseline and final-head CI before promotion.
